title: mentha viridis f. cordifolia
intro: Mentha viridis f. cordifolia, commonly known as Heartleaf Peppermint, is a subspecies of the peppermint plant (Mentha x piperita) characterized by its heart-shaped leaves. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to alleviate digestive issues, relieve nausea and headaches, and provide anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Heartleaf Peppermint include its carminative, expectorant, and antispasmodic properties, making it a popular remedy for digestive issues, respiratory problems, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Heartleaf Peppermint include menthol, menthone, limonene, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties and aroma.
